dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is image/video generation, prompt enhancement, gallery search, provider routing, and ComfyUI workflow management; the documented tools match that purpose.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Runtime instructions are scoped to user-directed creative workflows, including confirmation before generating multiple variants and explicit handling for user-provided reference images.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Installation runs a pinned third-party npm MCP server with npx meigen@1.3.3, which is disclosed and purpose-aligned but still means the user executes external package code.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill uses API tokens, provider network calls, optional local ComfyUI, generated output files, and user-supplied local reference images; these are sensitive but proportionate and disclosed for image generation.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: It stores provider configuration, preferences, generated files, and ComfyUI workflow changes, but I found no artifact evidence of cron jobs, startup scripts, hidden background workers, or unauthorized persistence.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.findings:
[RA2] unexpected: The cited evidence is the skill description, not a persistence mechanism; artifact review found only disclosed configuration, preferences, output saves, and workflow management tied to normal use.
[staticScan:clean] expected: Static scan reported no suspicious patterns, consistent with the markdown artifacts reviewed.
[VirusTotal:clean] expected: VirusTotal telemetry shows no malicious or suspicious detections across the supplied engine set; this supports but does not solely determine the benign verdict.
llm.guidance: Before installing, be comfortable running the pinned third-party npm package, configure API keys only for providers you trust, and remember that reference images may be sent to the selected external provider unless you use local ComfyUI.
llm.summary: This is a disclosed AI image/video generation skill whose file, network, credential, and local persistence behavior fits its stated creative workflow purpose.
